{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'new' segment and 'paid_search' channel
segments = sales['customer_segment'].unique()
channels = sales['channel'].unique()

print(f"Customer segments present: {segments}")
print(f"Channels present: {channels}")

# Check if there are any 'new' customers reached by 'paid_search'
filtered = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print(f"Number of new customers reached by paid search: {len(filtered)}")

# Check if there are any rows with revenue = 999999.99 (QA orders)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_neg1 = sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of customers with age = -1: {len(age_neg1)}")

# Display first few rows of the filtered population
filtered.head()"}
